title: Length of a binary operation table
statement: For any finite list $E$ of binary vectors of length $\ell$ over $\mathbb F_2$ and any binary operation on such vectors, the list of triples $(a,b,a*b)$ indexed by ordered pairs from $E$ has length $|E|^2$.
